instruction.text: Hera and Demeter are sisters. Select the correct goddess to learn more.

atoms.a: Hera, the queen of the gods and the goddess of marriage
atoms.sound: Heara, the queen of the gods and the goddess of marriage

atoms.b: Demeter was believed to protect ((++farmers programmers)). She was often shown with bundles of ((++wheat money)) to symbolise her connection to the land.
Hera, Zeus’ ((++wife son)), wears a crown to represent her role as the queen of all gods. She was believed to oversee ((++wedding tea)) ceremonies.
atoms.sound: Heara, Zeus’s wife, wears a crown to represent her role as the queen of all gods. She was believed to oversee wedding ceremonies.

atoms.b: Athena, often shown with an ((++owl octopus)) and a helmet, is the goddess of wisdom. The Greek city, ((++Athens Rome)), was named in her honour!
Aphrodite is the goddess of ((++love hate)) and beauty. Her symbols include doves, ((++roses cacti)), mirrors and seashells.
